name: Summon Genie, Lesser
body:
Summon Genie, Lesser
Source People of the Sands pg. 11
School conjuration (summoning); Level arcanist 4, cleric 4, oracle 4, sorcerer 4, summoner 3, summoner (unchained) 3, warpriest 4, witch 4, wizard 4
Casting
Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, F/DF (an oil lamp worth at least 50 gp)
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned genie
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no
Description
This spell functions like summon monster I, except you can summon one janni.
